metadata.name: auction_engine
metadata.description: Sealed-bid uniform-price batch auction: commit, reveal, clear, pro-rata allocation, issuer ROFR, per-fill DvP through payment-rails, print into mark-engine (SRS 08 §4.2, AE-P1..P11). Audit-scope-critical.

instructions.name: allocate
docs: AE-P6: pair allocated buyers and sellers into at most `max_fills`
new fills, in order-book order (deterministic, resumable). Moves to
IssuerRofr (ROFR configured) or Settling when every allocation is
paired. Permissionless.

instructions.name: clear
docs: AE-P5 + AE-P6 (margin): compute the uniform clearing price and each
order's allocation over the eligible orders. Permissionless once
reveals close and every revealed order is screened. A session with
too few eligible reveals, no cross at or above the reserve floor, or
a suspended mark fails (rails `fail_session`; all escrow refundable).
Remaining accounts: rails session, operator.

instructions.name: close_rofr
docs: AE-P7: end the ROFR window — the issuer declines (or is done), or
anyone once `rofr_end` has passed.

instructions.name: commit_ask
docs: AE-P3 sell side: record a sealed ask and escrow `qty` of the asset
(+ the bond). The rails asset vault must already exist and, for a
default-frozen asset, be gate-thawed. Remaining accounts: the rails
`DepositAsk` list.

instructions.name: commit_bid
docs: AE-P3 buy side: record a sealed bid and escrow `cash` (+ the bond)
in the rails. Remaining accounts: the rails `Deposit` list.

instructions.name: exercise_rofr
docs: AE-P7: the issuer takes `qty` of fill `fill_index` at the clearing
price, paid from its own account and settled at once (rails
`settle_rofr_fill`). The buyer's allocation shrinks by `qty`; their
unused cash is refundable after `finish`. Remaining accounts: the
rails `SettleRofrFill` list for the new fill index.

accounts.name: issuer
docs: The session's ROFR authority; pays cash and the receipt rent.

instructions.name: expire
docs: AE-P10: past `settle_deadline` (or past `reveal_end` while still in
Commit/Reveal and uncleared for the whole settle window), the session
fails; the rails then refund every escrow permissionlessly.
Remaining accounts: rails session, operator.

instructions.name: finish
docs: AE-P9: every fill settled → rails `finish_session` (unfilled escrow
refundable at once), then the clearing print into mark-engine.
Permissionless; the caller pays the print record's rent.
Remaining accounts: rails session, operator.

instructions.name: initialize_venue
docs: Create the venue. The signer is the venue operator authority (a
Squads vault on devnet/mainnet); `forced_sale_opener` is the only
key allowed to open forced-sale sessions (liquidity-facility's
PDA, AE-P11). Seeds the operator PDA with its rent float.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program, to locate its ProgramData. The singleton venue's authority opens every session: only the upgrade authority may create it.

instructions.name: open_session
docs: AE-P1: open a session. Remaining accounts: the rails `OpenSession`
list (config, cash session, asset mint, operator, system program)
followed by the operator's rails `EngineGrant`.

accounts.name: feed
docs: The asset's mark-engine feed (reserve + reference + print target).

accounts.name: opener
docs: Venue authority, or the forced-sale opener for a forced sale.

instructions.name: reveal
docs: AE-P4: reveal the preimage; checked against the commitment and the
escrowed amount, then reported to the rails (`mark_revealed`).
Remaining accounts: rails session, the owner's escrow, operator.

instructions.name: screen_ask
docs: AE-P6 gate check, sell side: screen revealed ask `order_index` —
block-list, and seasoned lots covering the revealed quantity (the
lots only season further before settlement). Permissionless once
reveals close. A failing ask is excluded, not an error.

instructions.name: screen_bid
docs: AE-P6 gate check, buy side: screen revealed bid `order_index`
against credit-gate (admission, block-list, SAS attestations through
the settlement horizon, lot-ledger room, `project_and_check`).
Permissionless once reveals close; the first screen moves the
session to Clearing. A failing bid is excluded, not an error.

instructions.name: set_forced_sale_opener
docs: Re-point the forced-sale opener (venue authority).

instructions.name: settle
docs: AE-P8: settle one fill through rails `settle_fill` (atomic DvP +
credit-gate `settle_check`). Permissionless; the caller funds the
fill receipt's rent. Remaining accounts: the rails `SettleFill` list.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Crank: funds the rails fill receipt.

types.name: ClearingPrint
docs: AE-P9: the session's aggregate print (mark-engine stores its own copy,
disclosed per the market's print policy).

types.name: Exclusion
docs: Why `screen_bid` / `screen_ask` excluded an order (AE-P6). Wire-stable;
append only.

fields.name: print_source
docs: auction-engine's print PDA (the only `record_print` signer).

fields.name: nav_pico
docs: Latest official NAV at [`NAV_SCALE`] (0 = never published).

fields.name: effective_ts
docs: When the NAV was written on-chain; ages are measured from here.

fields.name: last_drill
docs: The latest NAV came from `publish_drill_nav`.

fields.name: last_state
docs: Last evented state (transitions are evented once).

fields.name: implied_pico
docs: Implied NAV from the latest eligible print (0 = none).

fields.name: warn_after
docs: Age at which a Fresh mark becomes Warned.

fields.name: stale_after
docs: Age at which the mark becomes Stale.

fields.name: warned_haircut_bps
docs: Haircut applied while Warned (≤ `MAX_WARNED_HAIRCUT_BPS`).

fields.name: stale_haircut_bps
docs: Haircut applied while Stale or Suspended (≤ `MAX_STALE_HAIRCUT_BPS`).

fields.name: band_bps
docs: BANDED width, bps of price.

fields.name: min_print_volume
docs: Minimum print volume (base units) to enter the implied curve.

fields.name: min_print_investors
docs: Minimum distinct investor_ids on a print (G2).

fields.name: outlier_band_bps
docs: Maximum |print − NAV| / NAV for an eligible print.

fields.name: drills_enabled
docs: Devnet only: allow `publish_drill_nav` (AC-9 drill).

fields.name: rofr
docs: Issuer ROFR fill (settled at exercise).

types.name: MarkState
docs: ME-P2 mark states. `Suspended` is set only by `suspend`.

types.name: MarketConfig
docs: One immutable-per-market policy configuration (CG-P2).
Seeded per-mint. Every consumer (auction-engine sessions, facility
underwriting) snapshots the fields it depends on — the gate never
mutates config mid-session (L5 snapshot discipline). Updates are
governed by `gate_config_authority` and always evented (CG-P7).

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint this config governs.

fields.name: gate_config_authority
docs: Sole authority for this PDA. Starts as the gate root authority that
initialized it (#93; a single bootstrap key on devnet today, see
DEPLOYMENTS.md). Moves to the Squads 2-of-2 vault (SRS 08 §8) only
through `propose_gate_authority` + `accept_gate_authority`.

fields.name: policy_class
docs: Policy class (pilot: `PILOT_506C_TEST`) — stable u32 for consumers.

fields.name: identity_schema
docs: Accepted SAS identity schema (`nundina.identity.v1`, CG-P4/P6).
`eligibility::evaluate` (called by `validate`, `settle_check` and
`settle_check_rofr`) accepts an identity attestation only if it is a
SAS-owned account at its canonical PDA `["attestation", credential,
schema, holder]`, under `MarketPolicy::credential`, with this schema.

fields.name: accreditation_schema
docs: Accepted SAS accreditation schema (`nundina.accreditation.v1`,
CG-P6). Checked the same way as `identity_schema`.

fields.name: attesters
docs: Attester authorities accepted for these schemas. An attestation whose
SAS `signer` is not in `attesters[..attester_count]` is rejected
(`AttestationInvalid`); one expiring before now +
`settlement_horizon_seconds` is rejected (`AttestationExpiry`, H4).

fields.name: attester_count
docs: Active count into `attesters`.

fields.name: holder_cap
docs: Distinct investor_id cap (pilot: 8, CG-P4).

fields.name: seasoning_seconds
docs: Seasoning seconds (pilot: 7 days — compressed Rule-144 analog, CG-1).

fields.name: settlement_horizon_seconds
docs: Attestation must remain valid at least this long after validation (H4).

fields.name: blocklist
docs: Block-list header (CG-P5, [`BlockList`]). `None` = no list
configured: the screen passes. Set by `initialize_blocklist`;
re-pointable but never clearable. Pointing it anywhere but this
program's header for the mint makes every screen fail closed.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: MarketPolicy
docs: Per-market eligibility policy and the holder governor's count.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: credential
docs: The SAS credential this market accepts attestations under.

fields.name: jurisdictions
docs: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes allowed to hold; `[..jurisdiction_count]`.

fields.name: jurisdiction_count
docs: Live entries in `jurisdictions`.

fields.name: min_kyc_level
docs: Minimum `kyc_level` in the identity attestation.

fields.name: require_accreditation
docs: `accredited == true` required (Rule 506(c) policy classes).

fields.name: distinct_investors
docs: Distinct `investor_id`s currently admitted (CG-P4).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: escrowed
docs: Cash (buy) or asset (sell) escrowed in the rails at commit.

fields.name: alloc
docs: Allocation at the clearing price.

fields.name: alloc_left
docs: Allocation not yet paired into a fill (AE-P6 cursor).

fields.name: screened
docs: AE-P6: the gate check ran on this order.

fields.name: eligible
docs: AE-P6: it passed; only eligible orders clear.

types.name: OrderScreened
docs: AE-P6: one order's gate check. `exclusion` is `None` when it passed.

types.name: Phase
docs: AE-P2 phases (06 §2).

types.name: PrintPolicy
docs: ME-P6 print policy classes.

fields.name: feed
docs: mark-engine feed of the asset.

fields.name: rails_session
docs: payment-rails `CashSession` (operator = this program's PDA).

types.name: SessionParams
docs: AE-P1: everything snapshotted at open; immutable afterwards.

fields.name: rofr_window
docs: ROFR window length after `reveal_end` (0 with no ROFR authority).

fields.name: settle_deadline
docs: Hard deadline: settlement closes, every escrow refundable.

fields.name: bond
docs: Forfeitable bond per order (micro-USDC).

fields.name: max_cash
docs: Per-investor cash cap (micro-USDC).

fields.name: min_reveals
docs: Fewer revealed orders than this ⇒ Failed (G13).

fields.name: max_discount_bps
docs: Reserve floor = NAV_effective × (1 − max_discount_bps).

fields.name: forced_sale
docs: AE-P11: opened by the facility; no reserve; flagged print.

fields.name: rofr_authority
docs: Issuer ROFR authority; `Pubkey::default()` disables ROFR.

fields.name: disclosure_hash
docs: Hash of the session disclosure, carried on every transfer record.
